data.gender_notes: Rabiye is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One Who Is Kind and Merciful. The name Rabiye carries the meaning “The One Who Is Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rabiye usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who is kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who embodies the qualities of kindness, mercy, and compassion. It is believed that the name Rabiye will bring blessings of happiness, prosperity, and good fortune.
data.etymology: Rabiye belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Is Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rabiye total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ربيعة
in_arabic.meaning: الرابعة في السلالة أو النسل رابعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و معناه الرابعة في السلالة أو النسل رابعة، و يرمز إلى الترتيب و التميز في العائلة أو المجتمع، و هو اسم ذو أصول عريقة في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية و يطلق على الإناث كتعبير عن المكانة الرفيعة.

in_urdu.name: ربعیہ
in_urdu.meaning: نسلیں یا خاندان میں چوتھی نسل
in_urdu.long_meaning: ربعیہ کا مطلب ہے نسلیں یا خاندان میں چوتھی نسل، یہ نام عربی मूल کا ہے اور اردو میں اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلمانوں میں شائع ہے، یہ نام خاندان میں چوتھی نسل یا رکن کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقویم اور عربی ثقافت میں گہری جڑوں والا ہے.

in_hindi.name: रबीया
in_hindi.meaning: परिवार या वंश में चौथी पीढ़ी
in_hindi.long_meaning: रबीया नाम का अर्थ है परिवार या वंश में चौथी पीढ़ी, यह नाम अरबी मूल का है और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है, यह नाम परिवार में चौथी पीढ़ी या सदस्य के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, और यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा और अरबी संस्कृति में गहरी जड़ों वाला है.

in_pashto.name: ربعیہ
in_pashto.meaning: د کورنۍ یا نسل په څلورمې نسل
in_pashto.long_meaning: ربعیہ نوم معنی د کورنۍ یا نسل په څلورمې نسل، دا نوم عربي اصلي دی او په افغانستان کې د پښتنو په منځ کې کارول کيږي، دا نوم د کورنۍ په څلورمې نسل يا غړي لپاره کارول کيږي، او دا نوم د اسلامي دود او عربي کلتور کې ژورې ريښې لري.

in_english.name: Rabiye
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rabiye originates from Arabic roots, signifying the fourth generation or lineage. It holds significance in Islamic tradition and Arabic culture, symbolizing a notable position within a family or community. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting a connection to ancestral lineage and heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rabiye in Islamic culture represents kindness, compassion, and mercy. It serves as a reminder of the importance of treating all living beings with kindness and mercy, as this is a fundamental aspect of Islamic teachings. Rabiye is an excellent name for a girl who demonstrates these qualities and inspires those around her to be kind and compassionate as well.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Rabiye is rooted in the concept of Allah being the Ultimate Giver and the Most Merciful. By using this name, a Muslim girl is constantly reminded of the divine qualities of compassion, mercy, and generosity, which are highly valued in Islam. It is believed that someone with this name will be given the strength and blessings to embody these qualities in their own lives, thereby drawing closer to Allah and living a life filled with purpose and meaning.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The One Who Is Kind" symbolizes The One Who Is Kind and Merciful. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rabiye serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the one who is kind.
